data.name: Dead 4 Now: Rebirth of Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Dead 4 Now: Rebirth of Survivors is an FPS zombie-themed bullet hell game set in the Dead 4 Now universe. Fight against zombie hordes, improve your character with in-game improvements and skill tree training, and survive against bosses with various abilities. Kill and shred hordes of zombies! Gather skill points to improve your character. Use massive destruction guns to shred hordes of zombies!

GORE! GOREE! GOREEE!

Dead 4 Now doesn’t flinch. Every hit is designed to feel heavy, messy, and final, with splatter, chunks, and brutal impact that turns every close call into a spectacle you earned.

Kill & Shred Hordes of Zombies

The outbreak doesn’t come in small numbers. Survive relentless, screen-filling waves and carve a path through the dead in bullet-hell chaos defined by constant movement, tight dodges, and aggressive crowd control.

Use Massive Destruction Guns!

Bring hardware built for the end of the world, including high-rate bullet storms, explosive area denial, and experimental firepower that deletes problems fast. If it can break a horde, it belongs in your hands.

Character Progression

Earn levels, stack upgrades, and shape your survivor into a walking disaster. Spend points to push stats, unlock new tools, and build a playstyle that keeps scaling as the nights get worse.

  • Level up and get unique skills: Each time you level up while slaying zombies, you will get three choices to get an upgrade! These upgrades can help you acquire associates, such as a Helicopter (for illuminating the area and bombing zombies) or a Turret.

  • Every time you die, you earn experience based on your performance in slaying zombies. These experience points will give you skill tree points. You will use those skills to unlock new skills(active skills such as Grenade Launcher), guns and attachments, and buffs(passive skills such as +%10 Maximum HP)

Boss Fight

When the noise gets too loud, something answers. Face the lab’s first failures, unstable prototype horrors with signature patterns, punishing burst windows, and the kind of presence that turns a fight into a moment.

Each map includes a unique boss. Gather associates and improve your character to survive against hordes of zombies and the bosses!

More Info About Dead 4 Now Universe!

Dead 4 Now: Rebirth of Survivors is a bullet-hell game in the Dead 4 Now series. D4N: RoS uses the Dead 4 Now base systems. Dead 4 Now is an upcoming MMOFPS survival game scheduled for announcement in Q1 2027. For more information, join our Discord server and ask anything you would like to know about D4N: RoS or Dead 4 Now.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX 6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 780ti or AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K or Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
